config_name: Legion 5 15.1 Gen 10 — Core i9-14900HX / RTX 5070 8GB (115W), 32GB DDR5, 1TB SSD, 15.1" WQXGA OLED 165Hz

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB GDDR7 (115 W TGP incl. 95 W Dynamic Boost, MUX, no Advanced Optimus)
specs.ports: 2x USB-C 3.2 Gen2 (DP, PD 3.0; no USB4 on Intel model), 3x USB-A 3.2, HDMI 2.1, RJ45 GbE, 3.5mm

battery.notes: 80 Wh. NBC AMD anchor: 9.5h WiFi @150nits; Intel HX 'noticeably shorter' — est. ~6.5h. Full charge 95 min.

offers.name: Lenovo Legion 5 15.1" WQXGA 165Hz Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i9-14900HX - 32GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - RTX 5070 - Win 11 Pro - Black

reviews.quote: Combined with an excellent OLED display boasting a 165 Hz refresh rate and impressive brightness, gaming becomes an absolute pleasure. Thanks to the pre-installed color profiles, even demanding photo and video editing can be done with highly accurate colors.

professional.note: NBC reviewed the same 15IRX10 Intel chassis with RTX 5070 at 32GB (87%) — this tier matches the tested RAM size. RTINGS/Tom's: no numeric score found, not cited.

praises: 15.1" OLED 165 Hz with 0.9 deltaE and 99.9% P3 plus accurate preinstalled sRGB/P3 profiles — NBC calls it suited to demanding photo/video work
32GB DDR5 matches the NBC-tested config; two SODIMM slots to 64GB and dual M.2 make it the easy-upgrade tier
RTX 5070 at full 115 W with MUX — 'gaming performance is on par with the more expensive Legion 5 Pro 16' (NBC)
1.94 kg / 21.5 mm with comfortable 1.6 mm-travel keyboard + numpad; OLED chassis is lighter than the IPS version
Wi-Fi 7 (1820 MBit/s measured), 5MP webcam with eShutter, fast 95-min full charge
complaints: Intel HX power draw: NBC measured 'significantly more power' than the Ryzen model for little extra performance — battery ~3h worse than AMD tier
Fans clearly audible at 50.1 dB(A) in Performance mode (NBC)
No USB4/Thunderbolt on Intel models; no card reader (NBC cons)
Glossy-only panel reflects light; PWM flickering on the OLED (NBC cons)
Speakers 'could be better' (NBC); Legion Gen-10 threads report warranty friction and occasional OLED/fan quirks on the platform

design_philosophy: Lenovo's mainstream Legion 5 Gen 10 prioritises full-wattage GPUs, an optional superb OLED, and user serviceability over chassis flashiness. This tier is the balanced Intel config — the 32GB RAM size NBC actually tested, paired with the 24-core i9-14900HX and the line's OLED + RTX 5070 core experience.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC-reviewed 15IRX10 i7-13650HX/RTX 5070/32GB config (87%) per SHARED-legion5-oled.md: +0.5 productivity for the 24-core i9-14900HX vs tested 14-core i7, −1.5 battery vs AMD anchor (NBC: Intel draws much more power). 32GB matches tested config (no RAM penalty vs 101.json: +0.5 productivity, +0.3 ai_ml).
